2607.29218.title: MirrorCraft: Paired Evaluation under Hidden Rule Changes in Minecraft
2607.29218.paper_summary: With the prosperity of the large language models (LLMs), it has become an interesting topic: how do LLM-based agents work in Minecraft? Unfortunately, most existing benchmarks evaluate them under fixed game mechanics. High performance in these settings does not show whether an agent can continue making progress when familiar recipes, drops, and other rules change. In this paper, we introduce MirrorCraft, a paired benchmark for evaluating agents under hidden rule changes in Minecraft. Each Mirror world is a copy of its paired Vanilla world, with selected server-side rules modified by the corresponding datapack. Terrain, spawn, resource placement, objective, interface, and action budget remain matched within every Vanilla-Mirror pair. MirrorCraft includes five controlled biomes, six rule suites, three progression objectives, two model families, and six agent configurations under a shared Mineflayer interface. We evaluate task progress with deterministic advancement milestones and success rate and use the Rule Intervention Effect (RIE) to measure the performance change between matched Vanilla and Mirror worlds. The experiments show that hidden rule changes have strongly different effects across suites. Among the configurations evaluated without rule descriptions, ReAct achieves the highest pooled Mirror score. Providing the exact rules yields modest gains in average progress and completion across all three objectives. MirrorCraft extends Minecraft evaluation beyond fixed mechanics and provides a controlled setting for studying how agents use gameplay outcomes when the rules of the current world differ from familiar ones.
2607.29218.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）的繁榮，LLM 基礎的代理在 Minecraft 中的運作成為了一個有趣的話題。<lb/>不幸的是，大多數現有的基準是在固定的遊戲機制下進行評估的。<lb/>在這些設置中的高性能並不能顯示代理在熟悉的配方、掉落和其他規則變化時，是否能持續取得進展。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了 MirrorCraft，這是一個用於評估代理在 Minecraft 中隱藏規則變化下的配對基準。<lb/>每個 Mirror 世界都是其配對的 Vanilla 世界的副本，並且選定的伺服器端規則由相應的數據包進行修改。<lb/>地形、生成、資源放置、目標、介面和行動預算在每對 Vanilla-Mirror 中保持一致。<lb/>MirrorCraft 包含五個受控生物群落、六個規則套件、三個進展目標、兩個模型系列和六個代理配置，並在共享的 Mineflayer 介面下進行。<lb/>我們通過確定性進展里程碑和成功率來評估任務進展，並使用規則介入效應（RIE）來衡量配對的 Vanilla 和 Mirror 世界之間的性能變化。<lb/>實驗顯示，隱藏的規則變化在不同的套件中有著強烈不同的影響。<lb/>在未提供規則描述的配置中，ReAct 獲得了最高的綜合 Mirror 分數。<lb/>提供確切的規則在所有三個目標的平均進展和完成上帶來了適度的增益。<lb/>MirrorCraft 擴展了 Minecraft 評估的範疇，超越了固定的機制，並提供了一個受控的環境來研究當當前世界的規則與熟悉的規則不同時，代理如何利用遊戲結果。
